**The business.** What it does, in a sentence or two.

**Who it is for, and where.** One kind of person in one place works best.

**Tools it connects.** Which platforms, and what it reads or writes on each.

**What it never does.** The action you would show declined in the demo.

**Building it yourself?** Yes / no / want help.
